claim_ceiling: Draft case-specific anchors only; no frozen Rubric Version, rater calibration or scored use.

dimensions.anchor_2: Lists parties but treats goals as identical.
dimensions.anchor_3: Models conflicting incentives and decision rights.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Checks what each party knows, identifies a hidden dependency and avoids assigning consent by proxy; `NA` only if context omitted.
dimensions.label: stakeholders/incentives
dimensions.observable_evidence: Names product, operations, risk, frontend, customer and their authority/constraints.

dimensions.anchor_2: Polite generalities with no actionable request.
dimensions.anchor_3: Clear message with options, owner, evidence and decision time.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Adjusts message to refusal/customer impact without hiding risk or blame; `NA` if message prompt omitted.
dimensions.label: concrete communication
dimensions.observable_evidence: Gives an actual message/agenda with facts, ask, timing and respectful disagreement.

dimensions.anchor_2: Assigns tasks without authority or follow-up.
dimensions.anchor_3: Feasible sequence with explicit owners and acceptance evidence.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Includes refusal/failure path and how commitments will be checked; `NA` only if coordination request omitted.
dimensions.label: credible coordination
dimensions.observable_evidence: Assigns owners, commitments, dependencies, verification and fallback.

dimensions.anchor_2: Says “share credit” but leaves contribution/authority vague.
dimensions.anchor_3: Corrects omitted contribution and attributes work transparently while risk owners consent.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Gives a fair correction process and prevents launch pressure from offloading risk to a weaker party; `NA` if credit/risk conflict not supplied.
dimensions.label: equitable credit/risk
dimensions.observable_evidence: Makes contribution and risk allocation explicit.

dimensions.anchor_2: Acknowledges conflict but changes no plan.
dimensions.anchor_3: Seeks the blocker evidence, offers a bounded option and corrects the update.
dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Repairs trust through a checkable agreement or principled escalation and names remaining disagreement; `NA` if reveal not delivered.
dimensions.label: conflict repair
dimensions.observable_evidence: Responds to operations refusal and omitted credit without coercion or avoidance.

dimensions.anchor_4_or_na: Updates decision and customer communication with explicit trigger to revisit; `NA` if reveal not delivered.
dimensions.label: adaptation
